introduction.content_en: You need to recite Surah Al-Fatiha in every rakah of every prayer. After Al-Fatiha, you recite another short surah in the first two rakaat. Here are the essential surahs to memorize first. Start with Al-Fatiha, then learn the short surahs at the end of the Quran.
introduction.content_ar: تحتاج إلى قراءة سورة الفاتحة في كل ركعة من كل صلاة. وبعد الفاتحة تقرأ سورة قصيرة أخرى في الركعتين الأوليين. هذه أهم السور التي ينبغي حفظها أولًا. ابدأ بالفاتحة، ثم تعلم قصار السور من آخر القرآن.
introduction.notes: Audio for each surah can be fetched from the Al Quran Cloud API using the Mishary Alafasy edition (ar.alafasy). The agent should implement the audio player to fetch from: http://api.alquran.cloud/v1/surah/{number}/ar.alafasy

surahs.priority: MUST LEARN FIRST — Required in every rakah
surahs.priority_ar: يجب تعلمها أولًا، فهي ركن في كل ركعة

verses.translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful
All praise is due to Allah, Lord of all the worlds
The Most Gracious, the Most Merciful
Master of the Day of Judgment
You alone we worship, and You alone we ask for help
Guide us to the straight path

verses.arabic: صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ
verses.translation: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have earned anger nor of those who are astray

surahs.priority: Learn second — summarizes Tawhid (Oneness of Allah)

verses.translation: Say: He is Allah, the One
Allah, the Eternal Refuge
He neither begets nor is born

verses.transliteration: Wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad
verses.translation: Nor is there to Him any equivalent

surahs.priority_ar: تعلمها ثالثًا، وهي تعويذة من الشرور

verses.translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
From the evil of that which He created

verses.transliteration: Wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab
verses.translation: And from the evil of darkness when it settles
And from the evil of the blowers in knots

verses.transliteration: Wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad
verses.translation: And from the evil of an envier when he envies

surahs.priority_ar: تعلمها رابعًا، وهي تعويذة من وسواس النفس والشيطان

verses.translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind
The King of mankind
The God of mankind
From the evil of the retreating whisperer
Who whispers in the breasts of mankind
From among the jinn and mankind

surahs.priority: Additional short surah — shortest surah in the Quran
surahs.priority_ar: سورة قصيرة إضافية، وهي أقصر سور القرآن

verses.translation: Indeed, We have granted you Al-Kawthar (abundance)
So pray to your Lord and sacrifice
Indeed, your enemy — he is the one cut off

surahs.priority: Additional short surah — profound summary of success
surahs.priority_ar: سورة قصيرة إضافية، وهي تلخّص أسباب الفلاح في الدنيا والآخرة

verses.translation: By time
Indeed, mankind is in loss

verses.arabic: إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ
verses.transliteration: Illal-ladhina amanu wa 'amilus-salihati wa tawasaw bil-haqqi wa tawasaw bis-sabr
verses.translation: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience
